notes: compress::flate: Go-exact streaming inflate (byte-pull discipline, CorruptInputError offsets, preset dictionaries, Resetter) and a port of Go 1.27's compressor (the level 1-6 fast matchers, the level 7-9 lazy hash chains, Go's Huffman construction and block selection): output is byte-identical to Go's at levels -2..=9 for flate, zlib and gzip, including preset dictionaries and Flush schedules (checked by tools/flate_check.py; Go's own bytes are not covered by its compatibility promise, so a future Go may change them); I/O is std::io Read/BufRead/Write

CorruptInputError.note: tuple struct over i64; carried as the payload of an io::Error of kind InvalidData

CorruptInputError.Error.note: impl Display for rust_stdlib::compress::flate::CorruptInputError with Go's text

InternalError.Error.note: impl Display for rust_stdlib::compress::flate::InternalError with Go's text

NewReader.note: returns Decompressor, Go's io.ReadCloser; unbuffered sources are wrapped in BufReader like Go's bufio fallback; Decompressor::from_buf_read consumes a BufRead exactly as far as needed

NewWriter.note: levels -2..=9; an invalid level is an io::Error with Go's text

ReadError.Error.note: impl Display for rust_stdlib::compress::flate::ReadError with Go's text

Reader.note: io.Reader plus io.ByteReader is BufRead: sources are consumed byte-exactly through fill_buf/consume

Resetter.note: generic over the source type; implemented by flate::Decompressor and zlib::Reader

WriteError.Error.note: impl Display for rust_stdlib::compress::flate::WriteError with Go's text

Writer.Flush.note: sync flush (Z_SYNC_FLUSH): an empty stored block follows the pending data
